posts.text:
I think I need to fly to China just to buy more DGX Sparks.

A friend in China says you can get a DGX over there for around 30k CNY, which is like $4,400.

In Korea, retail is around $6,500, and even used ones go for $5,500.

Round-trip flights to China are only $100, so it completely makes sense to just fly over and grab few.

Why is Korea so expensive? @nvidia

posts.translation_zh:
我觉得我得飞去中国，就为了多买几台 DGX Sparks。

一位在中国的朋友说，在那边一台 DGX 大约 3 万人民币就能买到，也就是约 4,400 美元。

在韩国，零售价大约是 6,500 美元，就连二手的也要 5,500 美元。

往返中国的机票只要 100 美元，所以直接飞过去买几台完全说得通。

为什么韩国这么贵？@nvidia
